description: This Java class handles commands for modifying fixed deposit account applications within the Fineract platform. It implements the NewCommandSourceHandler interface, is annotated as a Service, and processes update commands for fixed deposit accounts by delegating to a service layer.

classes.name: FixedDepositAccountApplicationModificationCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles command processing to modify fixed deposit account applications, delegating the actual modification to a dedicated write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the provided JSON command to update a fixed deposit account application by calling the underlying service's modifyFDApplication method.
